input:
<question>
I keep getting 'no license available' in the mornings.
</question>
<passages>
[KB-503 §1] PLM license not available - PLM license not available
Engineer licenses are shared. **No license available** means all are in use. Licenses are released after 60 minutes of inactivity. If it keeps happening in your team, your manager can request more seats in the service portal under **Request > Software > PLM license seats**.

[KB-101 §2] Unlock a CAD file that is checked out by someone else - If the person is available
1. In the CAD vault client, right-click the file and choose **Properties > Checked out by** to see who has it.
2. Ask them to check the file in, or to choose **Undo check-out** if they made no changes.
</passages>
